reading: This position rules Love and Family, and it rules them from the quietest part of your chart, the seat you cannot perform from. The Steward lives inside your Day Gate, hidden in the ground of your own disposition: how you love works like a granary, filled slowly and opened only for the right hands. That habit thickens through your Home Chapter, the marriage years, when what you have saved finally shows its size. It arrives through the spouse, through the intimate self nobody else meets, and the return is never fast. It never disappears either.
teaser: You keep love like a granary keeps grain, counted and put away, not spent on just anyone. That patience pays out best in the marriage years.

domain_readings.Love: In love, you save the way a granary saves grain, one steady addition building toward something that lasts. Grand gestures rarely move you. What moves you is someone who shows up on the ordinary days, season after season, until the trust is finally worth keeping. Open slowly. Keep what proves itself.
domain_readings.Family: At home, you are the one quietly keeping things steady, noticing what everyone else forgets to track. You do not announce the effort, you just keep making it, harvest after harvest, patient as a granary filling one basket at a time. Family trusts you before they know why. Keep doing the small, unglamorous work. It holds the house together.
